name: Raleigh Andrean
summary: In the Undercity, Raleigh Andrean lives among the Forsaken. His requests show how little regard he has for his human life and those he once knew.

sections.title: A Bitter Afterlife
sections.body: Before the Third War, Raleigh Andrean lived in Lordaeron as a human. He was married to Deliah and counted Valdred Moray as a friend. The Scourge swept through the kingdom, killing Raleigh and raising him as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. After the Lich King's grip shattered and Sylvanas Windrunner led her uprising, Raleigh regained his free will and joined the Forsaken in the Undercity.

sections.title: Vengeance over Grief
sections.body: Raleigh Andrean's requests reveal how undeath has worn away his feelings. When Deliah's wedding ring is brought to him, he shows no sorrow or lingering love for his late wife. He dismisses her death and asks for the severed hands of Valdred Moray, his former friend who murdered her. Raleigh keeps the hands as a reminder of betrayal, not out of affection for Deliah. Whoever helps him receives a ring forged of pure scorn.

faq.answer: Raleigh Andrean lives in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity, among the Forsaken.

faq.q: Who was Raleigh when he was alive?
faq.answer: Before the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, Raleigh lived there as a human. He was married to Deliah and was friends with Valdred Moray.

faq.q: Why does Raleigh want revenge on Valdred Moray?
faq.answer: Raleigh wants revenge because Valdred Moray, his former friend, murdered Deliah. Raleigh asks for Valdred's severed hands.

faq.q: How did Raleigh become free from the Scourge?
faq.answer: During the Third War, the Scourge killed Raleigh and raised him as a thrall. After the Lich King's grip shattered, Sylvanas Windrunner led an uprising that freed Raleigh and many others, who formed the Forsaken.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how one Forsaken responds to undeath through Raleigh's treatment of his former human ties.
